need: Written before opening the document: the English-language literature on climate decision under uncertainty speaks of option value and the irreversibility effect. A reader working in English wants the place where a French thesis takes those two notions up and applies them to the greenhouse-gas stock and to deforestation. The query is English; the answer paragraph is French.
